tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search Toys Hub's catalogue by words, category, age and price. Returns name, price, availability, photo, product page and a buy-now link for each match.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Everything about one product: description, price, availability, age range, brand, photos, rating, delivery and payment facts, and a buy-now link.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: All product categories with their slug, name, product count and page.

tools.name: get_store_info
tools.description: Who the store is and how buying works: delivery countries, cost and time, payment methods, returns, currency, languages and contact.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Whether a product can be ordered now in the wanted quantity.

tools.name: get_shipping_quote
tools.description: Delivery cost and time for a city, and whether the order qualifies for free delivery.

tools.name: create_cart_link
tools.description: Make a link that opens Toys Hub's checkout with these products already in the cart. Give it to the shopper; they confirm and pay on the store's site. Nothing is ordered or stored by this tool.
